subject: MATHEMATICS
description: A term/side contribution disappears without applying the same legal operation to preserve equality.
observable_pattern: An equation changes by deleting, cancelling, or moving material without an equivalent equality-preserving transformation.

subject: MATHEMATICS
description: A compound expression is treated as though it were an independent variable or interchangeable scalar.
observable_pattern: The learner substitutes or equates a compound expression without preserving its dependence on its constituent variables.

subject: MATHEMATICS
description: The structural identity of a binomial square is broken.
observable_pattern: Expansion of (a±b)^2 omits/mis-signs 2ab or squares a term incorrectly.

subject: MATHEMATICS
description: x/y roles are mixed when interpreting ordered pairs or coordinate relations.
observable_pattern: Coordinates or differences are placed in the wrong semantic role, such as interchanging Δx and Δy in slope construction.

subject: MATHEMATICS
description: A sign is lost or changed during symbolic execution.
observable_pattern: Negation/subtraction/distribution changes a sign without a valid algebraic reason.

subject: MATHEMATICS
description: An invalid candidate solution is accepted without checking it against the original constraints.
observable_pattern: A final pair/value is reported even though direct substitution into the original relation fails.
